annotations.title: Get a purchase order's receive status

description: Report the most recent receive against a purchase order: pending / completed / failed, with the line ids received, pending and failed (and why). Returns 404 until something has been received. Sortly: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders/{purchase_order_id}/receive/status.
name: sortly_get_purchase_order_receive_status
title: Get a purchase order's receive status
